text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: White fitted sleeveless button blouse with pleated pintuck panels and broad textured straps, black triangle camisole with narrow violet straps visible at neckline. Lower half not shown: dark indigo jeans and black flats.. Add ONLY these accessories: A matched pair of small violet gemstone dangling earrings in antique silver settings.; A fine silver necklace with a round engraved silver locket pendant, entire chain visible in a closed oval.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Edit this exact product image. Remove the entire lavender scarf from neck and sides. Preserve the sleeveless white blouse with black/purple inner neckline, jeans, shoes, brown bag, pendant necklace and pair of purple earrings. No scarf or additional fabric. Preserve all other garment cuts, colors, textures and proportions. Keep pure white background, fully visible uncropped outfit and accessories, hollow empty garments without human body, skin or mannequin. Do not add anything.
